Name: fig Light and Dark presets for ReShade
Author: figtrane
Description:
I wanted to make a ReShade preset that tones down Stardew's blindingly bright colors without straying too far from the regular color palette. Then I also made a dark one.

Presets contain slight chromatic and edge blur effects because I personally prefer them. I suggest setting a keyboard shortcut to toggle them.

You can download both presets together or get them separately under optional files. Each zip comes with a preset and its required effects.
